svg.title: Use independent evidence for different failure classes
svg.desc: No allocator, device kernel or benchmark execution is claimed by this documentation
svg.text: Use independent evidence for different failure classes
No allocator, device kernel or benchmark execution is claimed by this documentation
Serialized lifecycle events → independent model and candidate
Compare verdicts, named owners/pins, identities, mappings and every slot.
Record the actual input history; seeds alone do not survive generator changes.
Faults and bounded schedules → replayable counterexamples
Preserve original and reduced histories with the same failure predicate.
Known completion drains to Free; unknown completion preserves quarantine.
Keep logical prefixes and masks fixed; compare logits and immutable KV.
In-bounds addresses and matching free counts cannot establish correct contents.
Scoped tools and controlled timing → qualified claims
Miri: executed host checks. Loom: instrumented modeled concurrency.
Device sanitizers and checker timing supplement semantics; neither proves all safety.
Pass relevant gates before timing. Record coverage, numerical scope and unresolved outcomes.
